result.stdout:
PeasyPilot CLI - Unified Test Runner
Usage:
  peasypilot [options]                                       Run tests
  peasypilot history                                         Show test execution history
  peasypilot suggest-tests --assembly <path> --type <name>  Generate test suite proposal

Test Execution Options:
  -f, --filter <name>         Filter tests by name (case insensitive)
  -c, --changed-files <f1,f2> Run impact analysis for comma-separated changed files
  -fmt, --format <format>     Output format: console, json, junit
  -o, --output <path>         File path to save JSON or JUnit report

Test Suggestion Options:
  -a, --assembly <path>       Assembly path to analyze (required)
  -t, --type <name>           Target type name to generate tests for (required)
  -fw, --framework <fw>       Target framework: xunit, nunit, tunit (default: xunit)
  -o, --output-dir <dir>      Output directory (default: ./generated-tests)
  -fmt, --format <fmt>        Output format: json, cs, both (default: json)
  --force                     Overwrite existing proposal files

  -h, --help                  Show help information
